scopeLabel: Fujitsu FMWORLD Japan business PC LIFEBOOK U series manufacturer model-specific manual index

universe.populationMethod: all explicit LIFEBOOK U series model links in manufacturer HTML table row, no family/serial guesses; includes archival business models
universe.notes: Manufacturer official FMWORLD LIFEBOOK page contains many other families (A, E, P, etc), explicitly out of this bounded U series scope. Live source captured all 148 official U series model hyperlinks, including new U9416NQ and U8316 variants not present in older search snapshots. Source digests must fail CI when models or exact linked URLs drift. Company-wide FMV remains incomplete. Live primary review completed 2026-10-31: official index source population 148/148 exact names and linked URLs match SHA256-locked snapshot; all 148 exact H1 manufacturer manual index pages have manufacturer-linked PDF artifacts passing HTTPS redirect, HTTP response, and %PDF- magic. 78 distinct PDF destinations checked; 148 direct / 0 shared / 0 support_only / 0 held. Manual directory points to per-model official manual index (which can list multiple manuals); identical subordinate PDFs do not make different model-specific index destinations shared.

review.notes: All 148 source-linked exact manual-index destinations and at least one linked PDF per model pass live checks; every direct record includes per-model manual index and one confirmed PDF artifact. Full manufacturer does not mean scope-complete outside U-series. Five archived 2012–2014 models use officially linked year-partitioned PDF folders rather than the current /pdf/ path, with exact URLs positively verified in live review; manifest reconciled to their real archived paths.
